title: The scalar components θ·ξ(α) of an integer multiplicity triple are H^n-integrable on compact pieces of the carrier
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and U, K ⊆ ℝ^P. Let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an integer multiplicity triple in U (R : IMRep U n), with M = R.carrier, θ = R.mult : ℝ^P → ℕ and ξ = R.orient : ℝ^P → Λ_n = MultiVector P n. Assume K is compact and K ⊆ U. Then for every n-covector α ∈ Λ^n = Covector (Euclid P) n, the real function x ↦ θ(x)·ξ(x)(α) is integrable on M ∩ K with respect to H^n = μHE[n] (Mathlib's normalized n-dimensional Hausdorff measure). In Lean: IntegrableOn (fun x => (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x α) (R.carrier ∩ K) μHE[n].
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U K : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, IntegrableOn (fun x => (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x α) (R.carrier ∩ K) μHE[n]
